_doc: VLA policy presets for the `vla` harness (--model PRESET). Each preset fixes the wire protocol, the observation template ({dotted key: source}; sources: camera, state, text, const), the action mapping onto the task's action vector and the chunk controller. Override any field with --policy-config FILE (JSON, merged on top). The server address comes from ROBOUSE_VLA_URL.

openpi/pi05_libero.licence: openpi code Apache-2.0; checkpoint gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi05_libero (PaliGemma-based, Gemma terms)
openpi/pi05_libero.doc: pi0.5 fine-tuned on LIBERO, served by openpi `scripts/serve_policy.py --env LIBERO` (GPU). Same observation as openpi's examples/libero/main.py: both cameras rotated 180 degrees from robosuite's raw frames and padded to 224x224, 8-D state (eef pos, axis-angle, gripper qpos), replan every 5 actions.

openpi/pi0_libero.doc: pi0 fine-tuned on LIBERO: openpi `scripts/serve_policy.py policy:checkpoint --policy.config=pi0_libero --policy.dir=gs://openpi-assets/checkpoints/pi0_libero`. Same observation as pi0.5.

openvla/openvla-7b-libero.licence: OpenVLA code MIT; weights per the model card (Llama 2 community licence for the backbone)
openvla/openvla-7b-libero.doc: OpenVLA fine-tuned on a LIBERO suite (openvla/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-{spatial,object,goal,10}) behind `vla-scripts/deploy.py`. One action per request; gripper from [0, 1] (1 = open) to LIBERO's -1 open / +1 close, as run_libero_eval.py does. Set unnorm_key to the suite.

molmoact2/libero.doc: MolmoAct2-LIBERO behind Robo Use's LeRobot server (`src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py`). Upright images; the server does LeRobot's LIBERO preprocessing.

lerobot/smolvla_libero.doc: SmolVLA fine-tuned on LIBERO (HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero) behind `lerobot_server.py -- --policy.path=HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero --env.type=libero ...` (runs on CPU, slowly, or GPU). SmolVLA-LIBERO names its cameras image and image2.

lerobot/pi05_libero.licence: lerobot/pi05_libero_finetuned_v044: Gemma terms; its tokenizer comes from the gated google/paligemma-3b-pt-224 (accept the licence, then set HF_TOKEN on the server)
lerobot/pi05_libero.doc: LeRobot's pi0.5 LIBERO port (lerobot/pi05_libero_finetuned_v044) behind `src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py` (`--env.type=libero --policy.n_action_steps=10`, cameras image and image2).

lerobot/pi0_libero.licence: lerobot/pi0_libero_finetuned_v044: Gemma terms; gated PaliGemma tokenizer as for lerobot/pi05_libero

lerobot/pi0fast_libero.licence: lerobot/pi0fast-libero: Gemma terms (PaliGemma base); gated PaliGemma tokenizer as for lerobot/pi05_libero
lerobot/pi0fast_libero.doc: LeRobot's pi0-FAST LIBERO port (lerobot/pi0fast-libero) behind `src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py` with LeRobot's documented flags (`--policy.max_action_tokens=256`, rename_map to base_0_rgb / left_wrist_0_rgb).

lerobot/groot_n1.7_libero.licence: GR00T N1.7 LIBERO checkpoints Apache-2.0 (nvidia/gr00t17-lerobot-libero_*-640); base nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B NVIDIA Open Model License
lerobot/groot_n1.7_libero.doc: GR00T N1.7 fine-tuned per LIBERO suite (nvidia/gr00t17-lerobot-libero_{spatial,object,goal,10}-640) behind `src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py` (lerobot_server.py, `--env.type=libero`); one server per suite. Cameras image and wrist_image, 16 actions per request.

lerobot/vla_jepa_libero.doc: VLA-JEPA fine-tuned on LIBERO behind `src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py` (`--env.type=libero`, cameras image and image2).

lerobot/evo1_libero.licence: EVO1 code MIT; zuoxingdong/evo1_libero weights 'other' (InternVL3 MIT, Qwen language component under the Qwen licence)
lerobot/evo1_libero.doc: EVO1 fine-tuned on LIBERO behind `src/robouse/harnesses/vla/lerobot_server.py` (`--env.type=libero`, cameras image and image2).

gr00t/so101.licence: Isaac-GR00T code Apache-2.0; GR00T N1.6/N1.7 weights NVIDIA Open Model License
gr00t/so101.doc: GR00T N1.6/N1.7 fine-tuned on an SO-101 (e.g. robocurve/gr00t-n1.7-so-101) behind `gr00t/eval/run_gr00t_server.py` (GPU). Absolute joint targets in LeRobot degrees; modality keys of the so100/so101 data config.

xpolicylab/metal-joint.licence: XPolicyLab Apache-2.0; each policy per its own licence
xpolicylab/metal-joint.doc: Any XPolicyLab-served policy (pi0/pi0.5, GR00T, OpenVLA-OFT, RDT-1B, SmolVLA, ACT, Diffusion Policy, ...) trained for a 6-joint arm + gripper with absolute joint actions, on the Metal arm. Observation Data Format v1.0.

openpi/generic.doc: Bring your own openpi observation keys with --policy-config.

gr00t/generic.doc: Bring your own GR00T modality keys with --policy-config.

xpolicylab/generic.doc: Bring your own XPolicyLab slots with --policy-config.
